title: Creative Thinking and Innovation Techniques
overview: Creativity stands out as a crucial factor contributing to the success of both organizations and individuals. While some view creativity as an inherent talent that individuals may possess or lack, contemporary perspectives emphasize it as a skill that can be cultivated and utilized by anyone within any organizational setting, provided the right nurturing conditions.

This course delves into the essential elements required to foster such an environment conducive to creativity. Drawing on examples from the realms of business, art, and science, and incorporating practical tools like brainstorming and mind mapping, participants gain the means to reshape their lives, surroundings, and workplaces.
audience: Supervisors, managers, team and project leaders, and individuals seeking to embrace a more creative approach in both personal and professional aspects of life. This includes those aiming to solve problems, generate innovative initiatives, instigate and implement changes, or address personal and organizational challenges through non-traditional methods.
methodology: This course employs a blend of interactive methodologies, combining concise presentations by the consultant with self-awareness tests, exercises utilizing recently acquired creative techniques, games, lateral thinking exercises, puzzles, case studies, and video clips. The comprehensive approach includes thorough debriefing sessions to enhance the learning experience.
competencies: Analytical skills for addressing problems and situations
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Evaluate their capacity for creativity and innovation
Utilize creative thinking skills and methods in both professional and personal scenarios
Engage in non-conventional thinking by employing "out of the box" approaches, such as mind mapping and picture associations
Apply diverse creative thinking strategies in a professional setting
Establish a positive work environment that fosters creativity for oneself and others
